result.topic_en: Gauss writes basic formulas for the mutual action of current elements and motions (electrodynamics, with the distance taken as the modulus of a complex quantity), then computes the contribution of rectilinear polygon sides to integrals such as X = ∫dx/r, and gives a formula for the area of a spherical triangle in terms of the volume of a pyramid.
